title: Research-only complete candidate output for prescribed groundwater-level mode-1 trials

control.rule: candidate groundwater_level_cm equals the prescribed trial coordinate, not raw legacy state.gwl
control.raw_legacy_gwl: diagnostic only; may remain the immutable accepted-origin groundwater level

materialization_rules: Materialize only after one HeadCalc trial from an immutable origin.
For LOW01-B inside-profile trials branch_id=INSIDE_PROFILE and effective groundwater level equals the requested level because near-node branch switching is reserved for LOW01-C.
groundwater_level_cm=requested_groundwater_level_cm when raw_gwlinp matches the request and the trial is valid.
qbot is copied from the HeadCalc diagnosed output and is never prescribed by the carrier.
complete-profile storage uses all declared layers, including saturated continuation below active Richards nodes.
valid requires finite state/qbot, no dt reduction, no alternative solver, expected inside-profile branch, and mass residual within the declared gate.

transaction_semantics.origin: owned outside the candidate and immutable
transaction_semantics.reject: destroy candidate only; no publication or mutation of origin
transaction_semantics.accept: not part of LOW01-B; later HLINK research may consume a valid candidate after conjunctive coupled acceptance

forbidden: do not overwrite raw HeadCalc state.gwl to make it look like the requested coordinate
do not expose this research carrier through production soil-water or F-GC ABI
do not infer branch continuity from LOW01-B
do not admit bottom_mode=1 in production
